crew.overview: Villainous Gru lives up to his reputation as a despicable, deplorable and downright unlikable guy when he hatches a plan to steal the moon from the sky. But he has a tough time staying on task after three orphans land in his care.
crew.title: Despicable Me

details.biography:
An award winning visual artist and mixed media filmmaker

with 20 years of experience in film and advertising industry, who has worked on Oscar winning productions such as Harry Potter, Narnia, Tim Burton's Dark Shadows.

Works as independent visual artist combining analogue media (large scale murals, collages) and digital technology (video, VFX and Augmented Reality).

Directed and produced award wining music videos for critically acclaimed postmodern classical composers.
details.name: Jola Kudela
